profile.name_en: New Scale MPM 3-Axis Piezo Micro-Positioning Stage
profile.description: 这是一种紧凑型三轴压电微定位模块，可通过网络进行控制，用于在实验中对样品、探针、光学元件或微型机械部件进行高精度位置调整与微米/纳米级运动控制。
profile.description_en: A compact 3-axis piezoelectric micro-positioning module with network control, used in laboratories for precise positioning and fine motion control of samples, probes, optical components, or small mechanical parts at micrometer to nanometer scale.
